subject: No warning for histogram x limits

messages.author: ee65f9feb643484e
messages.subject: No warning for histogram x limits
parts:
Dear ggplot2 group,

If I do a scatterplot and I specify the x limits or y limits such that some of the data is outside these limits, ggplot2 gives a warning, which I like. But if I do the same with the x limits for a histogram, there is no warning.

Example:

d <- data.frame(x = c(1:100), y = rnorm(100))

qplot(x, y, data=d, xlim = c(5, 95))  # warning
qplot(x, data=d, binwidth=5, xlim = c(5, 95))  # no warning

I'm wondering if anyone can explain the reason for not having a warning in the case of a histogram. I would find a warning in that case a very useful feature, as it would help me to avoid accidentally leaving out some of the data. Of course, I acknowledge that I should check the range of my data, but I would still find the warning very useful.

Thanks,
Mark Seeto
